source.name: 2024 Adult Compendium of Physical Activities
source.citation: Herrmann SD, Willis EA, Ainsworth BE, et al. 2024 Adult Compendium of Physical Activities: A third update of the energy costs of human activities. Journal of Sport and Health Science. 2024;13(1):6-12.
source.notes: The Compendium defines standard adult MET values and documents kcal conversion using body mass and activity duration.

displayRules.label: Estimated workout energy
displayRules.metEnergyLabel: Estimated from activity intensity, body mass and duration
displayRules.strengthNote: Do not pretend that a single set or named lift has a fixed calorie value. Resistance-training energy depends on load, pace, work/rest ratio and session structure; estimate timed sessions or segments instead.

bodyweight_high_intensity.description: Body weight resistance exercises, high intensity

resistance_general.description: Resistance training, multiple exercises, 8-15 reps at varied resistance

resistance_squat_deadlift.description: Resistance training, squats/deadlift, slow or explosive effort

resistance_vigorous.description: Resistance/free-weight or machine training, power lifting/body building, vigorous effort

circuit_kettlebell_vigorous.description: Circuit training including kettlebells, minimal rest, vigorous intensity
